The '''Nali-Erun clan''' was one of the clans of [[Senali (species)|Senalis]] that lived on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Senali]]. Sometime before [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]], the Nali-Erun clan was raided by the [[Homd-Resa clan]].<ref name="TSP">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Shattered Peace]]''</ref>
